verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is the preview-invoice API (POST /v1/invoices/create_preview), which could let a team estimate an upcoming invoice amount before it is finalized. Nothing in the pack covers usage metering, real-time accrued-cost views for customers or the team, or thresholds and alerts; webhooks and reminders relate to invoice lifecycle and collection, not usage. missing for 10: usage metering/current-cycle usage tracking, real-time accrued-cost dashboard for customers and team, configurable usage/spend thresholds, pre-invoice alerts, independent corroboration.
